text:
Jin: Kicking off a staggered percent rollout for v2.5.3. Plan: 0->5->20 over 25m. Change window 04:00-05:00 UTC. Starting NA slice. /deploy release=v2.5.3 percent=5 slice=na

deploy-bot: [04:00:02] Deploy started: v2.5.3 -> canary 5% (NA). CI: green. Dashboard: https://deploy.internal/r/3344556677

Marta: Watching NA telemetry. If errors >0.4% or p95 >220ms we hold and evaluate rollback.

Ibrahim: Spotting a small increase in tail latency on NA-west at ~04:03. p95 ~245ms, errors 0.2%. Sharing panel: https://grafana.internal/d/na/canary

eng-lead: If p95>230ms AND trending upward for 5m we pin NA to previous stable and pause global ramp. Decision call in this thread.

Jin: @sre-oncall can you run quick-checks on cache evictions and KV throughput?

sre-oncall: Running `./ops/check_kv --region=na --past=10m`. Initial: eviction spike at 04:02, KV qps up 60%. Could be warmup + small surfacing of a regression.

Marta: Given p95 and KV spike, I vote hold and pin NA to v2.5.2 for now. We avoid full rollback; manual pin keeps global progress.

Ibrahim: +1. Opening INC-4422 and adding traces. Will attach flamegraphs.

deploy-bot: [04:07:15] Action: pausing ramp. Applying region pin NA->v2.5.2 per operator request. Global canary remains at 5% excluding NA.

Jin: Pin applied. Setting a timer: if no QA+infra signoff by 04:35 UTC we schedule an automated staged rollback for NA at 04:45. Anyone object?

eng-lead: No objection. Set rollback timer. Also remind CS and update release notes: "NA slice paused; pinned to v2.5.2 while we investigate latency spike."

Marta: QA will run a focused suite (cache-heavy prompts) in an NA-like env. ETA 25m.

sre-oncall: Infra side: checking recent kernel updates and node churn. Will report within 15m.

Jin: Thanks. I'll keep thread updated. Use `/deploy resume` to unpin and continue if signoff comes earlier.

deploy-bot: [04:09:00] Note: rollback timer scheduled for 04:45 UTC for region=na unless cleared. Draft release note updated: https://docs.internal/releases/v2.5.3-draft

Ibrahim: Filing logs and linking: https://logs.internal/trace/4422

Marta: ack, pushing QA status when done.

Jin: Closing for now, will reopen if we need a vote to rollback earlier.
